title: CWP/4632/2025 of MANJIT KAUR Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHERS
text:
S. No.136 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH CWP No.4632 of 2025 Date of Decision:27.02.2025 Manjit Kaur .....Pe..oner Vs. State of Punjab and others .....Respondents CORAM:- HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPAK GUPTA Present:- Ms. Sonia G. Singh, Advocate for the pe oner. DEEPAK GUPTA, J. (Oral) Prayer in this writ pe on ﬁled by the pe oner under Ar cle 226 of the Cons tu on of India, is for issuance of a writ in the nature of mandamus, direc ng the respondents to release the complete re ral beneﬁts i.e. gratuity, leave encashment and arrears of pension, with a further prayer to direct the respondents to release the abovesaid amount along with 18% interest on delayed payment of above beneﬁts.

2. Pe oner also made a legal no ce dated 10.12.2024 (Annexure P.3) upon the respondents but no ac on has been taken so far upon the legal no ce.

3. Learned counsel also submits that the pe oner will be sa sﬁed in case the respondents are directed to take a decision on the legal no ce dated 10.12.2024 (Annexure P.3) by passing a speaking order.

4. No ce of mo on.

5. Mr. Rajesh Sehgal, Addl. AG, Punjab, accepts no ce on behalf of the respondents. He has no objec on to the prayer made by learned counsel for the pe oner.

6. I have heard learned counsel for the par es and have gone through the record of the case. Chandigarh CWP No.4632 of 2025 -27. Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case or the claim being made by the pe oner in the present pe on, respondents are directed to consider the grievances put forth by the pe oner in legal no ce dated 10.12.2024 (Annexure P.3), in accordance with law, by passing a speaking order within a period of three months from the date of receipt of cer ﬁed copy of this order.

8. The pe on stands disposed of. February 27, 2025 ( DEEPAK GUPTA ) renu JUDGE Chandigarh
